digest.component_or_area: test suite - store read operations under concurrent write
propositions: Two regression tests (original narrow oracle and generic property) were proposed for consolidation based on runtime overlap, but fault-seeded evidence shows the generic property misses the partial-success detection class (shape-valid but content-incomplete payloads like empty JSON or missing ticket_id fields) that only the original test catches.

Reverting the actual slim-fetch-ledge regression fix leaves both burst tests green; only the deterministic held-lock tests detect it, proving the storm oracle does not protect against the regression it is named for.

The generic property catches faults (long stalls, empty list output) that the original test misses, establishing bidirectional incompleteness and proving the two oracles are complements rather than duplicates.
Consolidation is unsafe under established mutation-score criteria (Just et al. FSE 2014) because removing the original test decreases fault detection coverage by losing F3 and F6 detection classes.
Both tests are retained; no modification to test or production files was made.
